channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Brendan Haywood | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Brendan Haywood from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kwame Brown on Brendan Haywood
item.description:
Kwame Brown:

“Everybody on my team got rookie hazing, except Brendan Haywood, because he went to North Carolina,”

Kwame Brown on Brendan Haywood, Jan 17, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kendrick Perkins on Brendan Haywood
item.description:
But Perkins said he thinks something is not right with the Dallas Mavericks big man who has played a total of 36 minutes in the first three games of the series.

“Brendan’s a good player, man. I remember when he was with the Wizards he was averaging a double-double, so you just never know,”

Kendrick Perkins on Brendan Haywood, May 5, 2012. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Tyson Chandler on Brendan Haywood
item.description:
Chandler told ESPN 103.3's Chuck Cooperstein.

“I’ve respected Brendan’s game for a long time. I competed against him a lot.”

Tyson Chandler on Brendan Haywood, Jul 15, 2010. Source: ESPN.com.
